registration.note: Sign up in person in the Children's Department on the morning of each story time. It is open to the first 25 children and their grown-ups. Groups of 5 or more should call ahead.

events.title: Toddler Storytime
events.address: 130 West Paces Ferry Rd NW, Atlanta, GA 30305
events.schedule: First Wednesday monthly, from 10am. Dec 2, Jan 6, Feb 3

registration.note: Add general admission tickets to your cart, then register for a storytime reading. In January the readings start at 10am and 11am, and each reading needs its own ticket.

events.title: Toddler Thursdays
events.venue: High Museum of Art, Greene Family Education Center
events.ageLabel: 15 months to 3 years with a caregiver
events.priceLabel: $23.50 ticket. Members and kids 5 and under free

registration.note: Register online, pick a time slot and buy tickets. Tickets include the galleries. Kids 5 and under are free, but add them to your head count.

events.description: Each month brings a new theme with related artworks, a hands-on art project and self-guided tours made for toddlers and their grown-ups.
events.sourceNote: high.org Toddler Thursdays page: every Thursday 10am-3pm in the Greene Family Education Center with slots 10am-12pm and 1-3pm, ages 15 months through 3 years, register online and buy tickets, $23.50 non-member ticket, members free, children 5 and under free with a head count, ticket includes galleries, no groups. Page says 'every Thursday' with no holiday closures listed. Sessions skip Thanksgiving, Dec 24 and Dec 31 to be safe. Address is the Woodruff Arts Center address from the ASO page footer.

events.ageLabel: 15 months to 3 years with a caregiver

registration.note: Included with museum admission. Come any time during the two-hour window.
